{{Quote|Get us into the Quence Sector, Elshandruu Pica. I have friends there.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], to [[Keevy Spart]]|<ref name="IJedi" />}}
The '''Quence sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Quence included [[Elshandruu Pica]], [[Xiunsrus]], and [[Suarbi 7]]. The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was represented in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] by first [[Elegos A'Kla]] and then [[Releqy A'Kla]].

Before [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] gambler [[Cunbus Locb]] visited several planets in this area, earned an amount of money, and left aboard his ship, ''[[Distant Wind]]'', to the chagrin of several fleeced locals.<ref name="stock">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
